title: RuACT: Recovering Inactive Rubrics as Adaptive Critics and Teachers
abstract: arXiv:2611.09597v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Rubric-based reinforcement learning (RL) extends RL with verifiable rewards to open-ended tasks by scoring each response against query-specific rubrics. Under group-relative optimization, however, a rubric that every sampled response fails (unreachable) or passes (saturated) gives all responses the same outcome and no learning signal; in Qwen3-4B medical training, 60.88% of query-rubric observations are inactive. We find that the two states lack different supervision: stating an unreachable rubric in the prompt raises its satisfaction from 1.13% to 91.25%, whereas responses that all pass a saturated rubric still differ in quality. We therefore propose RuACT (Rubrics as Adaptive Critics and Teachers), which assigns each inactive rubric the role that supplies what it lacks. Rubric as Teacher uses unreachable rubrics as privileged information for reward-gated on-policy self-distillation, and Rubric as Critic decomposes saturated rubrics int

translated_title: RuACT：将失活的评分标准恢复为自适应批评者与教师
translated_abstract: 基于评分标准的强化学习（RL）通过将每个响应与查询特定的评分标准进行对比打分，把带可验证奖励的强化学习扩展到了开放式任务。然而，在组相对优化下，当某个评分标准使所有采样响应都失败（不可达）或都通过（饱和）时，所有响应获得相同的结果，从而无法产生学习信号；在Qwen3-4B医疗训练中，60.88%的查询-评分标准观测处于失活状态。我们发现这两种状态缺乏不同的监督：在提示词中明确陈述不可达的评分标准可使其满足率从1.13%提升至91.25%，而全部通过饱和评分标准的响应在质量上仍然存在差异。因此，我们提出RuACT（将评分标准作为自适应批评者与教师），为每个失活的评分标准分配能够弥补其所缺信息的角色。“评分标准作为教师”将不可达评分标准用作特权信息，进行奖励门控的在策略自蒸馏；“评分标准作为批评者”则将饱和评分标准分解为……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: RuACT通过将不可达评分标准用作特权信息进行奖励门控自蒸馏、将饱和评分标准用作批评者来区分响应质量，使基于评分标准的强化学习中超过60%的失活监督信号重新产生有效学习信号。
en_tdlr: RuACT recovers inactive rubrics in rubric-based RL by using unreachable rubrics as privileged teacher information for reward-gated self-distillation and saturated rubrics as critics that discriminate response quality, turning over 60% of otherwise uninformative supervision into effective learning signals.
